description.en: Compare visible distances. It can be too sure of itself.
description.zh-CN: 比较看得见的距离。它有时太肯定。

description.en: Notice marks left by use, not their cause.
description.zh-CN: 留意使用过的痕迹，不推断原因。

description.en: Follow a familiar feeling; familiarity is not proof.
description.zh-CN: 跟着熟悉感走。但熟悉不算证据。
